metaDescription: Get complete clarity on your property's development potential with our comprehensive feasibility package.

hero.label: Clarity in five days.
hero.heading:
Complete Feasibility,

hero.lede: Five deliverables and a clear Go or No-Go on your project.
hero.ctaNote: No obligation. Response within one working day.

entry.heading: Feasibility From £49.99.
entry.lede: Both options start from the data. Pick the automated version for a fast overview, or go straight to the architectural feasibility if you want the full picture.

automated.name: Automated Site Feasibility
automated.strapline: Data-led. No design review. About 30 minutes.

architectural.name: Architectural Feasibility
architectural.strapline: Data, plus our design team: planning interpretation, sketch and layout testing, and a professional recommendation.
architectural.body: Everything in the automated appraisal, plus the sketch scheme and full report described below. Answer seven questions on the pricing page and your fixed fee is on screen.

entry.partnerPrefix: Only need a quick HMO screen?
entry.partnerSuffix: Opens hmochecker.co.uk in a new tab. A separate tool from a sister brand, not a Thistle feasibility.

steps.title: Secure Your Fixed Fee
steps.lead: Answer a few questions and pay online to lock in your fee. No obligation before this point, and no surprises after it.
steps.detail: The Architectural Feasibility takes a 50% holding deposit; the balance follows once your feasibility is delivered. The Automated Site Feasibility is £49.99, paid in full.

steps.title: Complete Your Project Brief
steps.lead: Your calculator answers carry forward automatically, so you pick up straight into plans, photos and the details that define the building.
steps.detail: You do not need detailed drawings. Basic floor plans, an address, and your initial assumptions on unit count are enough. If you do not have floor plans, we can often source them ourselves.

steps.title: Jodi Validates Your Brief
steps.lead: A short call with Jodi, our property expert, to check the brief and walk through your goals for the site.
steps.detail: Jodi captures anything specific to your plans for the building, so the analysis is pointed at the scheme you actually want. The Automated Site Feasibility skips this call and moves straight to analysis.

steps.durationLabel: Automated in around 30 minutes, design review over days 2 to 4
steps.title: Analysis, Then Design Review
steps.lead: Our data engine checks planning history, site constraints, density data and comparable schemes, before a designer sketches the optimal layout.
steps.detail: Hundreds of data points are cross-referenced across trusted sources first. This is the desk study, done in hours, not weeks. On the Architectural Feasibility, a designer then pressure-tests the data against the physical building and works through the spatial problems automation cannot solve. The Automated Site Feasibility stops after the data stage.

steps.title: Your Feasibility, Delivered
steps.lead: Architectural Feasibility: a final video call to review everything together. Automated Site Feasibility: your report, by email.
steps.detail: Either way you leave with complete clarity: the full feasibility document and a clear Go or No-Go. Enough to bid, to walk away, or to move into conveyancing with confidence.

faq.heading: The Practical Questions.
faq.lede: Fee, scope, VAT, what happens on a No-Go. The things that matter once you are ready to instruct.

items.question: Is the fee really fixed?
items.answer: Yes. The price you see is the price you pay, regardless of how the analysis unfolds. We absorb the cost if a deliverable takes longer than expected.

items.question: What isn't included in the fixed fee?
items.answer: Honest scope from the start. We can quote separately if any of these are needed.

exclusions.label: Planning application submission and full planning drawings.
Structural engineering surveys, party wall, or measured surveys.
Pre-application meetings with the local authority.
Detailed design or construction-stage architectural services.
Specialist reports such as daylight, transport, or ecology.

items.question: What if the recommendation is No-Go?
items.answer: You still receive the full report, the risk register, and the reasoning. You will know exactly why the scheme does not stack up and what would need to change. The fee is the same either way.

items.question: Do you charge VAT?
items.answer: All our feasibility fees are inclusive of VAT, so the price you see is the price you pay. VAT-registered businesses can normally reclaim the VAT element.

items.question: How quickly can you start?
items.answer: The five-day clock starts once both your payment and your full project brief are in, not just from payment. That's the point we have everything we need to actually begin the analysis.

items.question: Are revisions included?
items.answer: One round of layout revisions is included if the design-led stage surfaces options worth comparing. Beyond that we agree a fixed fee for further iteration.

items.question: What if my building is more complex than the package assumes?
items.answer: If the desk study flags genuine complexity, we will pause and agree a revised scope and fee with you before continuing. No surprises mid-feasibility.

items.question: Can the report be used to apply for funding?
items.answer: Yes. Reports include GDV projections, accommodation schedules, and a risk register, all structured to support lender, investor, and JV partner conversations.

items.question: What happens after a Go recommendation?
items.answer: You receive a fee proposal for the full project and a clear programme showing exactly what happens next. There is no obligation to proceed with us.
